description: US County Clerk Records - lis pendens, liens and deeds (Texas, Ohio, Michigan and more). Daily index of documents recorded with US county clerks in selected counties across Texas, Ohio, Michigan, Pennsylvania, Colorado and other states (counties enum in the input): lis pendens, liens, deeds, deeds of trust, releases, affidavits of heirship and sheriff's deeds, with recorded date, document category and grantor and grantee names. Use for pre-foreclosure and probate lead lists, lien monitoring on a named party, and title research. Pick counties and a recorded-date window (at most 31 days per run; the newest day can still be incomplete while the county finishes indexing), optionally document categories or a party name (counties index people as LAST FIRST). onlyNewSinceLastRun makes a scheduled run deliver each document once. No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

counties.description: The counties to read, from the county clerk's official public records search. Counties are read one after another.
counties.title: Counties

dateFrom.description: First recorded date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: yesterday. At most 31 days per run.
dateFrom.title: Recorded from

dateTo.description: Last recorded date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: yesterday. Counties publish each day once their indexing is done, so the most recent day can still be incomplete.
dateTo.title: Recorded to

documentCategories.description: Keep only these kinds of documents. Leave empty for every document recorded in the window. Each document gets one category, matched on the county's document type wording.
documentCategories.title: Document categories

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResults.description: Most documents delivered in this run, across all counties. 0 = no limit.
maxResults.title: Max results

onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: For a scheduled daily feed: skips documents this feed already delivered (remembered for 60 days), so a window that overlaps the previous run still delivers each document once.
onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only documents not delivered before

partyName.description: Only documents where this name appears as a grantor or grantee, e.g. "SMITH JOHN" or a company name. Counties index people as LAST FIRST. Leave empty for every document in the window.
partyName.title: Party name (optional)

stateStoreName.description: Key-value store in your Apify account that remembers delivered documents. Use a different name for each independent feed.
stateStoreName.title: Feed memory store name

name: regdata_us_county_recorded_documents
